text:
The answer is 31%, not my earlier ~50%: the shared team note lists only 91% and 31% as options, and 31% fits a bribe-payment rate for public services far better than 91%. I can't verify this against the 2017 Global Corruption Barometer data myself, so it rests on that note and plausibility. My earlier 50% figure was a guess and should be disregarded.

CONFIDENCE: 60
